guides.title: Reverse camera blank or blurry
guides.summary: The parking camera shows a black screen, a blurry or foggy picture, or a 'not available' message.

steps.text: Clean the camera lens (above the number plate or near the boot handle) with a soft damp cloth.
steps.detail: Mud and water drops cause most blurry pictures.

steps.text: What do you see when you reverse?

options.label: A black screen or 'camera not available'
A picture, but foggy from inside
A picture with lines or flicker

steps.text: Switch the car off, lock it, wait 5 to 10 minutes, start and try reverse again.
Think back: was an accessory (dashcam, screen, reversing lights) fitted, or the rear bumper repaired recently?
steps.detail: Wiring disturbed during fitting or repair is a common cause; tell the workshop.

steps.text: Moisture inside the camera can't be cleaned from outside and needs service, often under warranty.

escalate.text: The camera or its wiring needs a check.
tell_service: Black screen, foggy picture or lines
Whether it started after rain or a car wash
Any recent accessory fitting or rear bumper repair

guides.title: Parking sensors beep all the time, or not at all
guides.summary: The sensors beep with nothing behind the car, beep continuously, or stay silent.

steps.text: Clean the round sensors in the bumper.
steps.detail: Mud, water, dust or a sticker makes them beep all the time.

steps.text: Check nothing sits in front of a sensor: a tow hook, a bike carrier, a number plate frame or a bumper guard.
Try on a flat, dry surface; heavy rain and steep ramps can cause false beeps.
Check the parking sensors aren't switched off (a button with a P and sound waves, or a setting on the screen).

escalate.text: A sensor or its wiring may need a check.
tell_service: Front or rear, and which side if the car shows it
Any recent bumper repair or painting
